title: energreen.it
description: ENERGREEN S.p.A. is an Italian manufacturer of professional brush-cutters and remote-controlled machines under the RoboGreen brand. Registered at Via Sabbioni 16, 36026 Pojana Maggiore (Vicenza), Italy. Founded in 1999 by Daniele Fraron, who remains CEO to this day. In June 2022 the company was acquired by Venetian private equity fund 21 Invest through a standard LBO and reorganised as an S.p.A. By 2025 the group reported revenue of €116 million, employs 241 people, and operates across five continents.
